calls.statement:
SELECT
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(net_sales_contribution), 2) as net_sales
FROM (
  SELECT 
    CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) as transaction_date,
    SUM(sl.net_amount) as net_sales_contribution
  FROM fact_sales_line sl
  JOIN fact_web_order wo ON sl.receipt_id = wo.web_order_id
  JOIN dim_store ds ON sl.store_key = ds.store_key
  WHERE ds.store_id = 900
  GROUP BY transaction_date
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT
    rl.return_date as transaction_date,
    -SUM(rl.refund_net) as net_sales_contribution
  FROM fact_return_line rl
  JOIN dim_store ds ON rl.store_key = ds.store_key
  WHERE ds.store_id = 900
  GROUP BY rl.return_date
) combined
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = combined.transaction_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period

calls.statement:
SELECT
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(net_sales_contribution), 2) as net_sales
FROM (
  SELECT 
    CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) as transaction_date,
    SUM(sl.net_amount) as net_sales_contribution
  FROM fact_sales_line sl
  JOIN fact_web_order wo ON sl.receipt_id = wo.web_order_id
  JOIN dim_store ds ON sl.store_key = ds.store_key
  JOIN dim_product dp ON sl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE ds.store_id = 900 AND dp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY transaction_date
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT
    rl.return_date as transaction_date,
    -SUM(rl.refund_net) as net_sales_contribution
  FROM fact_return_line rl
  JOIN dim_store ds ON rl.store_key = ds.store_key
  JOIN dim_product dp ON rl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE ds.store_id = 900 AND dp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY rl.return_date
) combined
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = combined.transaction_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
